eligibility_reason: Reproduction is an independent first-class objective for the original grid-reaching missing-observation experiment. Its causal/smoothed endpoint and companion families are source defined, but the complete original ratio panel, numerical targets/intervals, historical data/fold/mask/readout bindings and justified reproduction criteria are unrecovered. The source-only reconciliation and numerical prediction scorer do not supply executable derivation from authentic data. This independently precludes an eligible or design_ready reproduction endpoint, without treating the distinct improvement effect requirement as a reproduction requirement.

source_paper.title: Dynamical flexible inference of nonlinear latent factors and structures in neural population activity

evidence.locator: Figure 7e; Extended Data Figure 6e–f; Methods: 2D grid reaching task, Evaluation using 5-fold cross-validation, Behaviour prediction accuracy—Motor datasets, Inference analyses with missing observations
evidence.supports: Defines grid-reaching behavior prediction, complete temporal support, fivefold evaluation, observed-ratio masks and distinct filtering/smoothing conditions. Full text reviewed through Europe PMC fullTextXML for the same PMCID.

Pearson correlation is calculated per output dimension, stored as float32, then aggregated after the explicit NaN handling; fit/apply z-scoring is separate. Current code lineage does not establish historical Figure 7 parity.

evidence.locator: Version v2 record description; variable names; Supplements session list
evidence.supports: Public source has sorted spikes, cursor position and timestamps for Indy/Loco; identifies seven listed 20160622_01–20160921_01 sessions with raw-data supplements. These listings do not alone establish the exact seven analysis files used by DFINE.

evidence.locator: Figure 7e and caption; Results: DFINE can perform flexible inference with missing observations; Methods: Inference analyses with missing observations
evidence.supports: Original grid-reaching filtering/smoothing behavior-CC curves, session/fold means and 95% confidence bounds. Text explicitly discusses observed ratios 0.2, 0.6 and 1, smoothing above filtering across all ratios, above-chance performance at 0.2 and relatively unchanged performance at 0.6. Neither the full ratio roster nor numerical ordinates/intervals are recovered.

evidence.locator: Extended Data Figure 6e–f; caption inherits a–b definitions for the grid-reaching dataset; Figure 4 bar/dot/asterisk convention; Results: missing observations
evidence.supports: Smoothed behavior predictions for DFINE, LDM, SAE zero imputation and SAE last/next-observation average imputation at observed ratios 0.3 and 0.6, with fully observed references. Six nonlinear-model percentage drops from 1 to 0.3 or 0.6; lower DFINE degradation than both SAE controls. Exact drop calculation and inferential aggregation are unrecovered.

evidence.locator: DFINE.forward: a_filter, a_smooth and behv_hat routing
evidence.supports: Returns separate filtered and smoothed factors. Convenience behv_hat uses a_smooth or static a_hat, never a_filter; it cannot supply the original causal curve merely by changing behv_from_smooth. Original separately fitted behavioral readout still requires binding.

evidence.locator: LDM.compute_forwards and backward smoothing; Git blob 1c5df19717b9002ff3e2a87db15f0295c5a1d52a also present at publication-day commit c278035be4b750caab6e0d2cd57e2e9a09484a15
evidence.supports: Missing observations set the filtering gain to zero; forward recursion predicts and updates from present/past inputs, while backward smoothing uses future inputs. Blob identity does not authenticate the historical experiment caller or enforce participant access.

target.description: Predict cursor x/y position and x/y velocity at every test timepoint under source-defined missing neural observations, separately for causal filtering and noncausal smoothing; retain full Figure 7e curves and Extended Data 6e–f comparisons.

dataset.description: The paper uses public O’Doherty/Sabes grid-reaching recordings. Zenodo 3854034 v2 supplies the relevant data family, but exact release/file/hash correspondence to the DFINE analysis remains unbound; the dataset’s unrelated decoder-result CSV is not a DFINE reference.

cohort.description: Seven sessions of Monkey I from 20160622/01 through 20160921/01, right-hemisphere M1, are source specified. Recover the exact seven recording identities and selected neurons before admission; all seven are required and one monkey does not support independent-animal inference.

split.description: Source uses five equal folds per session, training on four and testing on one. Exact ordered folds, temporal alignment and missing-mask realizations/replicates are unrecovered. rho ranges from 0.2 to 1, with exactly (1-rho)*100 observations dropped per 100 steps; full ratio grid and partial-block behavior require binding. A new blocked/held-session split is an extension.

inputs.description: Fully observed training neural activity; test neural activity contains the fixed source masks. Filtering accesses present/past observations only; smoothing may access future observations. Test behavior and dropped neural values remain evaluator-only. The behavioral readout is trained from smoothed training factors.

preprocessing.description: Source specifies top 30 behavior-predictive neurons, 10 ms spike bins, causal Gaussian smoothing with 30 ms SD, 50 ms sampling and training-statistic z-scoring. Historical neuron selection, ordered support and readout/hyperparameter selection need a source-bound implementation; changing those choices must not silently change the published comparison.

metric.description: Behavior Pearson CC on all test times, including missing-neural times: r_d=sum((y_d-mean(y_d))*(p_d-mean(p_d)))/sqrt(sum((y_d-mean(y_d))^2)*sum((p_d-mean(p_d))^2)), then arithmetic mean over four dimensions. Current author code maps NaN correlation to zero before the dimension mean; historical caller parity remains a separate binding gate. Higher is better.

aggregation.description: Figure 7 curves average over sessions and cross-validation folds, with source confidence bounds. All 35 session-fold cells and every original ratio are required for each inference regime; historical mask-replicate handling and numeric curve values are unresolved. The paper does not specify a single integrated loss across ratios.

full_panel.description: Retain every original Figure 7e ratio-specific causal and smoothed behavior-CC ordinate and 95% confidence bound, all Extended Data 6e LDM and SAE zero/last-next-average smoothed controls at 0.3/0.6 with full-observation references, and all six Extended Data 6f percentage drops plus their directional/statistical companions. The declared scalar findings cover source-confirmed ratios only; the remaining Figure 7e ratio grid is unrecovered. Before admission, expand to every authenticated original ratio and recover its numerical values and intervals. These findings are an incomplete source-unresolved panel, never a reduced-panel substitute or a scalar integrated curve.

permitted_observations.description: Fit latent models to fully observed training neural activity and the behavioral MLP to smoothed training factors with training behavior. At each test time filtering may use only present/past retained neural observations; smoothing and SAE last/next imputation may use retained future neural observations. Neither path may read dropped neural values or test behavior. Predict all four behavior dimensions at every original test time. A current-code DFINE.forward call returning a_filter alongside a_smooth does not enforce this information boundary, and behv_hat is not a filtered-factor readout.
